Sam (Support): Escalating BrightGate onboarding — intermittent embedding 504s during live demo windows. They said renewal sync is in 48h; customer said they may push the decision if issues persist. Ticket BG-9001 created.
Lydia (CS Ops): Acknowledged. Please confirm deployment type, model, and paste a short log sample. I'll draft comms and a mitigation plan.
Sam (Support): Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-1), model embed-xg-lite (4-bit). Failures concentrated on /v1/embeddings/bulk. Sample: `TS=2026-05-10T09:12:07Z REQ=81b4 model=embed-xg-lite status=504 latency_ms=1580 err=kv-evict`. Seen 4 failures in last 6 hours.
Rhea (CSM): I'll own customer-facing comms and run a 30-min enablement. Proposed comms: immediate ack + ETA 2h, temporary routing to embed-xg-stable for demo windows, offer 750 free embed units, and a recorded troubleshooting session. Clark AE can you confirm renewal slot?
Clark (AE): Renewal meeting in 2 days at 14:00 UTC. Prefer to avoid contract concessions; goodwill credit OK if engineering commits to follow-up. I'll attend the enablement.
notif-bot: Incident created: INC-BG9001 assigned to eng-runtime, priority=P1.
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): Quick triage shows KV cache churn driven by large shared prefixes and aggressive batch coalescing. Short-term mitigation: tenant_single_batch flag + route BrightGate demo routes to embed-xg-stable. I can flip flags for a 3-hour window now. Need a representative failed payload for deeper repro.
Sam (Support): Redacted payload: "parse intake form -> canonicalize entities" failed at 2026-05-10T09:12:07Z. Autoscale is fixed dedicated pool; burst disabled. Full traces attached to INC-BG9001.
Lydia (CS Ops): Action items summary:
- Ibrahim (eng-runtime): enable tenant_single_batch & route to stable (owner) 5m mitigation window now; propose durable config by EOD.
- Rhea (CSM): send ack + schedule 30m enablement and include Clark.
- Sam (Support): attach all traces to INC-BG9001 and add customer-facing note.
- Clark (AE): prepare renewal note template and join enablement.
Rhea (CSM): Ack sent to BrightGate offering mitigation and 750 embed credits; scheduled enablement for 12:00 UTC. Customer replied: "Thanks — please prioritize before our renewal." :pray:
Ibrahim (eng-runtime): Mitigation applied: tenant_single_batch=true and demo routes routed to embed-xg-stable. Early metrics: tail 99p latency dropped from ~1.6s to ~120ms. Monitoring for 2h. Opening RFC for batch heuristic adjustment and tenant cache sizing.
Lydia (CS Ops): Great. We'll reconvene after the enablement to finalize a short status note for Clark's renewal call and decide on permanent tuning or fallback policy. Keep this thread updated.
notif-bot: Label cs-escalation added to INC-BG9001.
